meta.title: Metro Denver apartment vacancy and rent (AAMD quarterly report)
meta.source: Apartment Association of Metro Denver, Vacancy & Rent Report (researched by Apartment Insights)
meta.geography: Denver metro (Adams, Arapahoe, Boulder/Broomfield, Denver, Douglas, Jefferson)
meta.capture: By hand from the executive summary PDF. The monthly market-rents workflow checks report_url_pattern for the next quarter and opens an issue (label aamd-vacancy) when it is published.
meta.methodology: Stabilized vacancy excludes communities still in lease-up; overall vacancy includes them. Average rent is gross rent and does not account for concessions (AAMD's own note).
